title: People Ops - self notes & manager prep
content:
Notes to self - performance check-in + 1:1 prep

Context:
- Role: Sr. People Ops Partner (supporting Eng + Product). Focus: hiring velocity, onboarding quality, manager enablement.
- Timeframe covered: last 6 months (Aug 2025 -> Feb 2026).
- Purpose: capture wins, concrete examples, blockers to escalate, and questions for manager ahead of mid-year sync.

Top accomplishments (concise bullets + evidence):
- Improved time-to-offer for Eng core roles from 36 -> 27 days (tracked in JIRA-PO-213). Key actions: revamped interview scorecard, introduced optional pre-screen template, aligned hiring templates with hiring managers.
  - Evidence: two hires (backend eng, infra) moved from first screen -> offer in 18 and 23 days; hiring manager feedback: "smoother process, clearer expectations".
- Launched onboarding pulse for new hires (first-week NPS survey) - 62 responses, avg score 4.3/5. Quick adjustments made: clearer runbook links, buddy pairing within 48 hrs.
- Manager enablement workshops: piloted 3 sessions (hiring manager training, onboarding best practices, inclusive interviewing). Attendee NPS: 4.2/5. Follow-ups: one-pagers created and shared in CON-4872.
- Small wins: standardized offer email template (reduced negotiation time), updated benefits FAQ for EMEA hires (reduced questions to HR inbox).

Concrete impact metrics I own / track:
- Time-to-offer (median) - current: 27 days (goal: 24 by EOY).
- Offer acceptance rate - current: 84% (goal: >88).
- New hire first-week NPS - current: 4.3/5 (goal: 4.5).
- Hiring manager satisfaction (post-hire survey) - pilot: 4.1/5.

Examples for performance conversation (stories):
- Story: "Backend team urgent hire" - background: critical headcount for infra sprints; action: pulled recruiting + SWE hiring manager into an alignment call, shortened interview loop (removed redundant system design step), provided daily candidate summaries; result: candidate accepted after 5 days of loop; impact: preserved sprint velocity for two-week milestone.
- Story: "Onboarding friction -> retention risk" - identified repeated confusion around environment access; action: made a small cross-team task force (Eng infra, IT, SRE) to create a one-click access checklist; result: drop in access-related tickets from new hires by ~70% in the first month.

Areas to improve / stretch goals:
- Move hiring median to 24 days: need more pre-screen capacity (contract sourcers?), better prioritization from Hiring Managers.
- Raise offer acceptance to >88%: work on counter-offer playbook, manager negotiation prep, clearer total compensation narrative.
- Automation: build a light dashboard for hiring pipeline forecasts (stakeholders: recruiting, finance). I'm comfortable owning spec + PMing a small dashboard project.
- Career growth: want exposure to compensation benchmarking and broader HRBP work - ask for a 3-month rotation or shadow with Priya.

Blockers / asks for manager:
- Headcount to support sourcer coverage for Eng (current sourcer capacity reaching limits) - ask: can we request 0.4 FTE uplift for Q2 via hiring plan?
- Approval to run a small pilot for automated offer letters (legal check needed) - ask: can you loop in legal and OK the pilot?
- Prioritization clarity: need explicit hires labeled "high priority" for next quarter from Eng leads; otherwise pipelines stall.

Feedback I want from manager in the 1:1:
- Does my impact look aligned with our team goals / comp expectations? Specific thoughts on promotion timing.
- Which cross-functional projects should I deprioritize to free up time for the hiring dashboard?
- Feedback on handling a difficult hiring manager (Dan R.) who repeatedly expands requirements mid-process.

Calibration / performance evidence I should prepare (to fine-tune before formal review):
- Data packet: time-to-offer trend, offer acceptance trend, hiring manager satisfaction survey, onboarding NPS. (Need to pull updated numbers from HRIS + recruiting)
- 2-3 short written manager testimonials (ask Priya and Daniel for a line each).
- Concrete project impact: quantify sprint misses avoided / cost saved where possible.

1:1 agenda (compact):
- Quick wins (2 min) - highlight the top 2 metrics improved
- Blockers & asks (5 min) - sourcer capacity, legal for offer pilot, prioritize hires
- Career path (5 min) - discuss promotion timeline + exposure request
- Feedback + next steps (3 min) - alignment and specific actions

Notes to self (tone / phrasing to use in sync):
- Be concise and metrics-first - manager has limited time.
- Bring clear ask (e.g., "I need approval to hire 0.4 FTE sourcer for Q2. Impact: reduce time-to-offer by ~3 days; expected ROI: faster ramping, lower contractor need").
- Offer 1-2 options for each ask (preferred vs fallback).

Follow-ups after meeting (TODOs):
- Pull latest hiring metrics and add to data packet (owner: me) - due: 2026-03-06.
- Draft sourcer req justification and share with Priya for review - due: 2026-03-09.
- Email legal about offer automation pilot and request a short timeline (owner: manager or Priya) - aim: response by 2026-03-12.
- Ask Daniel for a brief testimonial and permission to include his quote in calibration doc.

Misc / random notes:
- Keep screenshots from JIRA-PO-213 and CON-4872 for audit trail.
- Save onboarding pulse raw survey CSVs to my users folder.
- If promotion conversation moves forward, propose a stretch goal: lead a small cross-functional project to implement the hiring dashboard (spec + PM).

End of notes.
